IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/1] 7 of 37 subjects left CBT, 11 of 35 subjects left SBFT, and 11 of 35 subjects left NST.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/6] The 7 subjects who were removed on clinical grounds and referred for open treatment were referred because of persistent MDD; 1 subject also was suicidal. The 7 subjects referred for open treatment, compared with 29 who, although not referred, also had BDI>13 and MDD at week 6, were more likely to have comorbid dysthymic disorder (71.4% vs 20.7%; \chi^2=6.84; df=1; P=.009; Bonferroni corrected \alpha=.05/5=.01)
